mapper.select: SELECT t.*, s.scene_name FROM task_info t LEFT JOIN scene_info s ON t.scene_id = s.id WHERE t.id = #{id} AND t.deleted = 0
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM task_info WHERE status = #{status} AND deleted = 0
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM task_info WHERE status = #{status} AND deleted = 0 AND DATE(created_at) = CURDATE()

SELECT t.id, t.task_name, t.status, t.priority, t.plan_start_time AS planStartTime, t.plan_end_time AS planEndTime, t.actual_start_time AS actualStartTime, t.actual_end_time AS actualEndTime, s.scene_name, s.id AS sceneId, GROUP_CONCAT(d.device_name) AS deviceNames FROM task_info t LEFT JOIN scene_info s ON t.scene_id = s.id LEFT JOIN task_device_rel tdr ON t.id = tdr.task_id AND tdr.is_active = 1 LEFT JOIN device_info d ON tdr.device_id = d.id WHERE t.deleted = 0 AND t.status NOT IN (-20) AND t.scene_id = #{sceneId} AND DATE(t.plan_start_time) = #{date} GROUP BY t.id ORDER BY t.plan_start_time ASC

SELECT t.id, t.task_name, t.plan_end_time AS planEndTime, t.status, s.scene_name, TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, t.plan_end_time, NOW()) AS overdueMinutes FROM task_info t LEFT JOIN scene_info s ON t.scene_id = s.id WHERE t.deleted = 0 AND t.status IN (20, 30) AND t.plan_end_time < NOW() ORDER BY overdueMinutes DESC

SELECT COUNT(1) AS total, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 10 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pending, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 20 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS assigned, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 30 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS running, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 50 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS completed, SUM(CASE WHEN status = -20 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cancelled FROM task_info WHERE deleted = 0
SELECT status, COUNT(1) AS cnt FROM task_info WHERE deleted = 0 GROUP BY status
SELECT s.scene_name, COUNT(t.id) AS taskCount FROM scene_info s LEFT JOIN task_info t ON t.scene_id = s.id AND t.deleted = 0 WHERE s.deleted = 0 GROUP BY s.id, s.scene_name ORDER BY taskCount DESC

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(t.date_day, '%Y-%m-%d') AS date, COUNT(ti.id) AS newTasks, SUM(CASE WHEN ti.status = 50 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS completedTasks FROM ( SELECT DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL n DAY) AS date_day FROM (SELECT 0 n UNION SELECT 1 UNION SELECT 2 UNION SELECT 3 UNION SELECT 4 UNION SELECT 5 UNION SELECT 6 UNION SELECT 7 UNION SELECT 8 UNION SELECT 9 UNION SELECT 10 UNION SELECT 11 UNION SELECT 12 UNION SELECT 13 UNION SELECT 14 UNION SELECT 15 UNION SELECT 16 UNION SELECT 17 UNION SELECT 18 UNION SELECT 19 UNION SELECT 20 UNION SELECT 21 UNION SELECT 22 UNION SELECT 23 UNION SELECT 24 UNION SELECT 25 UNION SELECT 26 UNION SELECT 27 UNION SELECT 28 UNION SELECT 29) n WHERE n.n < #{days} ) t LEFT JOIN task_info ti ON DATE(ti.created_at) = t.date_day AND ti.deleted = 0 GROUP BY t.date_day ORDER BY t.date_day ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO task_info(task_name, task_code, scene_id, priority, device_count, plan_start_time, plan_end_time, description, status, created_by, updated_by, created_at, updated_at) VALUES(#{taskName}, #{taskCode}, #{sceneId}, #{priority}, #{deviceCount}, #{planStartTime}, #{planEndTime}, #{description}, #{status}, #{createdBy}, #{updatedBy}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE task_info SET deleted = 1, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE task_info SET status = #{status}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
